== History ==

After the [[Trolls]] of the [[Darkspear Tribe]] were forced to flee the [[Echo Isles]], [[Vol'jin]] relocated his people to the southern coast of [[Durotar]].  Vol'jin named the village after his former master, who fell while saving his people from rampaging Murlocs long ago. Vol'jin now resides in [[Orgrimmar]] in order to be on hand should he be needed by [[Thrall]]. In his stead, he has left the troll, [[Master Gadrin]] in charge of seeing to the needs of the small village.

== Overview ==

Usually the first town most [[orc]]s and [[troll]]s encounter on their adventures after around level 5. The road from the [[Valley of Trials]] leads east to a crossroads. The path to Sen'jin heads souutheast, while the other path turns north toward [[Razor Hill]]. 

=== Resources ===

Has some [[Class]] trainers and some [[Professions|Profession]] trainers.

Mounts: Raptors

== Inhabitants ==

* [[Lar Prowltusk]] - The eastmost troll who you should first encounter on your way from the [[Valley of Trials]]
* [[Master Gadrin]] - Located at the pool of water in the middle of the village
* [[Master Vornal]] - Located near Master Gadrin
